title: Towards Fewer Annotations: Active Learning via Region Impurity and Prediction Uncertainty for Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Select target regions by region impurity (class entropy in a neighbourhood) times prediction uncertainty for domain-adaptive segmentation.
adaptation: Rank the 1,152 pool half-cells (E1-like, half-cut, scuff) by RIPU score and pseudo-label the top ones with the PF ensemble; if a minimal labelling case is accepted, label 20-30 RIPU-chosen regions.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + top 300 RIPU-ranked pool half-cells pseudo-labelled. Baseline: PF variant. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU. Kill: < +0.02 E1 relF1@2.
evidence: R: 69.6 mIoU GTAV to Cityscapes with 2.2% labelled pixels vs 66.6 for LabOR. Code at github.com/BIT-DA/RIPU per search results, not opened.
prior_overlap: Synthetic half-cut views n.d.; selection of real half-cut pool cells not run. Open.
